const now = new Date();
const runId = `run-${now.getTime()}`;
const effectiveRootRunId = $json.rootRunId ? $json.rootRunId : runId;
const effectiveAttemptNumber = $json.attemptNumber ? $json.attemptNumber : ($json.revisionOfRunId ? "2" : "1");
const effectiveCarryForwardDesignReference = $json.carryForwardDesignReference ? $json.carryForwardDesignReference : ($json.revisionOfRunId ? "true" : "false");

const prepareCommand =
  `powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\\dev\\PathOS\\n8n-lab\\scripts\\prepare-run.ps1"` +
  ` -RunId "${runId}"` +
  ` -RunsRoot "${$json.runsRoot}"` +
  ` -RepoPath "${$json.repoPath}"` +
  ` -BranchName "${$json.branchName}"` +
  ` -Goal "${$json.goal}"` +
  ` -DayNumber "${$json.dayNumber}"` +
  ` -TaskTitle "${$json.taskTitle}"` +
  ` -Notes "${$json.notes}"` +
  ` -WorkType "${$json.workType}"` +
  ` -RequiresVisualApproval "${$json.requiresVisualApproval}"` +
  ` -AllowCursorHandoff "${$json.allowCursorHandoff}"` +
  ` -AllowCodexHandoff "${$json.allowCodexHandoff}"` +
  ` -AllowFinalReview "${$json.allowFinalReview}"` +
  ` -ReviewStatus "${$json.reviewStatus}"` +
  ` -RevisionOfRunId "${$json.revisionOfRunId ?? ""}"` +
  ` -RootRunId "${effectiveRootRunId}"` +
  ` -AttemptNumber "${effectiveAttemptNumber}"` +
  ` -ReviewFeedback "${$json.reviewFeedback ?? ""}"` +
  ` -RevisionReason "${$json.revisionReason ?? ""}"` +
  ` -CarryForwardDesignReference "${effectiveCarryForwardDesignReference}"` +
  ` -RevisionSummary "${$json.revisionSummary ?? ""}"` +
  ` -PreviousDesignSource "${$json.previousDesignSource ?? ""}"` +
  ` -PreviousReferenceImagePathCopied "${$json.previousReferenceImagePathCopied ?? ""}"` +
  ` -PreviousDesignNotesPathCopied "${$json.previousDesignNotesPathCopied ?? ""}"` +
  ` -ReferenceImagePath "${$json.referenceImagePath ?? ""}"` +
  ` -DesignNotesPath "${$json.designNotesPath ?? ""}"` +
  ` -DesignSource "${$json.designSource ?? ""}"` +
  ` -ForceTargetedModification "${$json.forceTargetedModification ?? "false"}"` +
  ` -AllowedTargetFiles "${Array.isArray($json.allowedTargetFiles) ? $json.allowedTargetFiles.join("|") : ($json.allowedTargetFiles ?? "")}"` +
  ` -NoOpOnTargetFilesIsFailure "${$json.noOpOnTargetFilesIsFailure ?? "false"}"`;

const repoStateCommand =
  `powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\\dev\\PathOS\\n8n-lab\\scripts\\collect-repo-state.ps1"` +
  ` -RunId "${runId}"` +
  ` -RunsRoot "${$json.runsRoot}"` +
  ` -RepoPath "${$json.repoPath}"`;

const preflightCommand =
  `powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\\dev\\PathOS\\n8n-lab\\scripts\\preflight-git.ps1"` +
  ` -RunId "${runId}"` +
  ` -RunsRoot "${$json.runsRoot}"` +
  ` -RepoPath "${$json.repoPath}"` +
  ` -BranchName "${$json.branchName}"` +
  ` -AllowBranchCreate "${$json.allowBranchCreate}"`;

const runIndexCommand =
  `powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\\dev\\PathOS\\n8n-lab\\scripts\\update-run-index.ps1"` +
  ` -RunId "${runId}"` +
  ` -RunsRoot "${$json.runsRoot}"` +
  ` -RepoPath "${$json.repoPath}"` +
  ` -BranchName "${$json.branchName}"` +
  ` -Goal "${$json.goal}"` +
  ` -RunStatus "prepared"` +
  ` -RevisionOfRunId "${$json.revisionOfRunId ?? ""}"` +
  ` -RootRunId "${effectiveRootRunId}"` +
  ` -AttemptNumber "${effectiveAttemptNumber}"` +
  ` -RevisionReason "${$json.revisionReason ?? ""}"`;

const promptBuildCommand =
  `powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\\dev\\PathOS\\n8n-lab\\scripts\\build-prompts.ps1"` +
  ` -RunId "${runId}"` +
  ` -RunsRoot "${$json.runsRoot}"` +
  ` -RepoPath "${$json.repoPath}"` +
  ` -BranchName "${$json.branchName}"` +
  ` -Goal "${$json.goal}"` +
  ` -DayNumber "${$json.dayNumber}"` +
  ` -TaskTitle "${$json.taskTitle}"` +
  ` -Notes "${$json.notes}"` +
  ` -WorkType "${$json.workType}"` +
  ` -RequiresVisualApproval "${$json.requiresVisualApproval}"` +
  ` -AllowCursorHandoff "${$json.allowCursorHandoff}"` +
  ` -AllowCodexHandoff "${$json.allowCodexHandoff}"` +
  ` -AllowFinalReview "${$json.allowFinalReview}"` +
  ` -ReviewStatus "${$json.reviewStatus}"` +
  ` -RevisionOfRunId "${$json.revisionOfRunId ?? ""}"`;

const statusUpdatePreparedCommand =
  `powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\\dev\\PathOS\\n8n-lab\\scripts\\update-run-status.ps1"` +
  ` -RunId "${runId}"` +
  ` -RunsRoot "${$json.runsRoot}"` +
  ` -NewStatus "ready_for_cursor"` +
  ` -ReviewStatus "${$json.reviewStatus}"` +
  ` -StatusNote "Run prepared and prompts built"`;

return [
  {
    json: {
      ...$json,
      runId,
      prepareCommand,
      repoStateCommand,
      preflightCommand,
      runIndexCommand,
      promptBuildCommand,
      statusUpdatePreparedCommand
    }
  }
];

const body = $json.body ?? $json;

const normalized = {
  project: body.project ?? "pathos-frontend",
  workspaceRoot: body.workspaceRoot ?? "C:\\dev\\PathOS",
  platformRoot: body.platformRoot ?? "C:\\dev\\PathOS\\apps\\pathos-platform",
  repoPath: body.repoPath ?? "C:\\dev\\PathOS\\apps\\pathos-platform\\frontend",
  n8nLabRoot: body.n8nLabRoot ?? "C:\\dev\\PathOS\\n8n-lab",
  runsRoot: body.runsRoot ?? "C:\\dev\\PathOS\\n8n-lab\\runs",
  scriptsRoot: body.scriptsRoot ?? "C:\\dev\\PathOS\\n8n-lab\\scripts",
  branchName: body.branchName ?? "feature/day-75-n8n-dev-pipeline-v1",
  goal: body.goal ?? "Test n8n automated dev pipeline",
  dayNumber: body.dayNumber ?? 75,
  taskTitle: body.taskTitle ?? "Bootstrap n8n-only PathOS frontend dev run",
  notes: body.notes ?? "This is an n8n-only automation experiment.",
  acceptanceCriteria: Array.isArray(body.acceptanceCriteria) ? body.acceptanceCriteria : [],
  docsToRead: Array.isArray(body.docsToRead) ? body.docsToRead : [],
  allowBranchCreate: body.allowBranchCreate ?? false,
  runStatus: body.runStatus ?? "initialized",

  workType: body.workType ?? "ui",
  requiresVisualApproval: body.requiresVisualApproval ?? true,
  allowPromptGeneration: body.allowPromptGeneration ?? true,
  allowCursorHandoff: body.allowCursorHandoff ?? true,
  allowCodexHandoff: body.allowCodexHandoff ?? false,
  allowFinalReview: body.allowFinalReview ?? false,
  reviewStatus: body.reviewStatus ?? "pending",
  revisionOfRunId: body.revisionOfRunId ?? null,
  rootRunId: body.rootRunId ?? "",
  attemptNumber: body.attemptNumber ?? "",
  reviewFeedback: body.reviewFeedback ?? "",
  revisionReason: body.revisionReason ?? "",
  carryForwardDesignReference: body.carryForwardDesignReference ?? "false",
  revisionSummary: body.revisionSummary ?? "",
  previousDesignSource: body.previousDesignSource ?? "",
  previousReferenceImagePathCopied: body.previousReferenceImagePathCopied ?? "",
  previousDesignNotesPathCopied: body.previousDesignNotesPathCopied ?? "",
  referenceImagePath: body.referenceImagePath ?? "",
  designNotesPath: body.designNotesPath ?? "",
  designSource: body.designSource ?? "",
  forceTargetedModification: body.forceTargetedModification ?? "false",
  allowedTargetFiles: Array.isArray(body.allowedTargetFiles) ? body.allowedTargetFiles : (body.allowedTargetFiles ? [body.allowedTargetFiles] : []),
  noOpOnTargetFilesIsFailure: body.noOpOnTargetFilesIsFailure ?? "false",
};

return [{ json: normalized }];
